title: Kanna Repo Config
description: Schema for .kanna/config.json used by Kanna agents and editors. The same schema describes the optional machine-local companion file .kanna/config.local.json, which is read from the checkout's working tree (never from origin), is gitignored, and is deep-merged over this file with local winning. That file may set only: agentProviders, workflow, ports, setup, teardown, test. Any other key in it is an error, not an ignored line. agentProviders and ports merge entry by entry with the local entry replacing the committed one of the same name; everything else replaces outright, and arrays never concatenate.

flavors.description: Per-role built-in agent flavor selections. A stage with agent "pr" uses flavors.pr when present; an explicit selector such as "pr@draft-pr" takes precedence. Repo overrides and extensions remain role-scoped at .kanna/agents/<role>/AGENT.md and EXTEND.md.

agentProviders.description: Repo-level provider, model, and effort preferences by agent name or * glob. Exact names win; otherwise the matching glob with the most non-* characters wins, with lexical order breaking ties. Provider/model/effort resolution is explicit task or stage override, then this map, then layered AGENT.md/EXTEND.md frontmatter, then the global default. A machine-local .kanna/config.local.json replaces individual entries of this map for that checkout only, which is how one machine reorders providers around an outage without a commit. Model and effort ids are provider-specific, so they are never composed across layers: resolution walks this same chain and takes the first layer that both names a value and would itself have selected the resolved provider, skipping any layer written for another provider. An entry's model and effort therefore belong to the provider that entry selects, which is the first name in its provider list; a fallback candidate listed behind that name takes its value from a lower layer written for that candidate, or else runs on its own stamped or default value.

model.description: Model id for the provider this entry selects — the first name in `provider`. It is not applied to any other provider, including a fallback candidate listed behind that name; such a candidate takes its model from a lower layer written for it, or runs on its own stamped or default model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for the provider this entry selects — the first name in `provider`. Effort vocabularies are provider-specific, so this value is not applied to any other provider; a fallback candidate listed behind that name takes its effort from a lower layer written for it, or runs on its own stamped or default effort.

vars.description: String variables substituted in AGENT.md bodies with $NAME or ${NAME}. Runtime prompt variables such as $BASE_REF, $BRANCH, $KANNA_TASK_ID, $PREV_RESULT, $SOURCE_WORKTREE, and $TASK_PROMPT remain runtime-bound and are not replaced by config vars.
